digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate, acceptance criteria tagging and verification
propositions: The tag [operator-attested] must be renamed to [non-codebase] to correctly signal that evidence lives outside the codebase rather than implying human-specific attestation
[operator-attested] must be retained as an undocumented compatibility alias to prevent reclassification of 827 existing tickets carrying the tag in the immutable event-sourced store
The canonical regex pattern must accept both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] case-insensitively using a non-capturing alternation so findall() arity remains unchanged

The kind wire value and all emitter/reader sites (completion_verifier.md, contracts.py, schema, audit/page.py, criteria_routing.json) must be cut over in lockstep to prevent divergence between deterministic matcher and LLM classification
All recognition-side prompts and activation triggers (.rebar/criteria_routing.json, completion_verifier.md, plan_review_evidence_kind.md) must be widened to accept both spellings
Author-facing guidance (writing-a-passing-plan.md, coach_moves.py messages) must emit [non-codebase] only and contain no documented references to [operator-attested]
